messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "no information on effects on a breastfed baby or on milk supply"
set: ["no information on effects on a breastfed baby or on milk supply", "effects of escitalopram on baby", "effects of duloxetine on baby", "effects of trazodone on baby", "tracking effects of venlafaxine on the baby", "on dialysis", "milk supply if low", "pregnancy registry may be used to track effects on baby", "immediate effects of alcohol on coordination", "immediate effects of alcohol on thinking", "no side effects identified in breastfed babies", "2% on placebo", "people on dialysis", "registry is used to track the effects of methylphenidate on the baby", "restrictions on its prescribing", "cut back on salt"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
